name: 06035 · Granby, CT
findings: ZIP 06035 (Granby) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06035 (Granby) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 06035 (Granby) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 57% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 53% of all organizations here have no identified type.
